crop.notes: Whole 'Between the Races' column of race-day gossip; the Allen line is in crop 2

ocr.notes: Mostly right; a few small errors (e.g. 'M. J. Murray' for M. J. Murphy, 'Bap Gay' for Bad day)

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican's race-day gossip column noted that prize-fighter Tom Allen, ex-champion, bet on Cuban Queen at the St. Louis races because her father was named Strathmore.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Wednesday Morning, June 16, 1886, page 6 (Missouri Republican, not yet the St. Louis Republic)

notes: One-line mention in a gossip column; a bet at the races is too minor for a biography fact.
